1.
The learned counsel for the respondent no.3 submits that he has filed a reply to the amended petition.
The same is, however, not on record.
The counsel shall have the same placed on record.
The delay in filing of the reply shall be treated as condoned.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within a period of four weeks.

2. By the amended petition, the petitioner inter alia seeks to challenge the Award dated 25.11.2017 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (West-01), Delhi (hereinafter referred to as the 'Tribunal') in new MACT Case No. 477088/2016, titled Sh. Moses S. Dass v. Sh. Rajiv Kumar &
Ors. in so far as the learned Tribunal has refused to grant compensation to the petitioner herein for the cost and regular replacement of the prosthetic limb.
